methodology: Separate Next production builds on the same checkout and host; one warmup and median of five HTTP reads. Byte sizes are uncompressed unless labeled gzip. Script counts are unique initial HTML script references, not complete browser network request counts. Local cached timings do not represent deployed traffic.

api.note: Summary API was already paginated before this task; the new gain is avoiding full content and research in the database query.
